i.norm: Verifies that parsing succeeds when stopAtNonOption is true and the argument array contains a single token that resembles a short option with an equals sign (e.g. "-=};SP'") but does not match any registered option. With stopAtNonOption enabled, the parser should stop at the unrecognized token and return a valid CommandLine rather than throwing.
Register an option with short key "js4" that accepts an argument
Build an argument array with 32 slots; only slot 23 contains a token
Parse with stopAtNonOption=true: the unrecognized "-=};SP'" token causes the parser to stop and collect remaining tokens as arguments rather than throwing
